title: Unified content calendar
description: Plan and preview every channel's queue in one drag-and-reorder calendar, so nothing goes out of order or off-brand.

title: Smart send-time windows
description: Define recurring send windows per channel and Beacon fills them automatically, spacing a week of content evenly without manual rescheduling.

title: Team review, built in
description: Leave threaded comments on a queued post before it ships, with unread badges so nothing slips past review.

title: Reporting you can export
description: Every performance chart ships with a CSV export, so the data behind it is never locked inside a dashboard.
